arguments.code:
# Load full note content, update the checkbox for 'Taking a solo backpacking trip' to not done
note_id = 3041
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token)
content = note['content']
old_line = '[x] Taking a solo backpacking trip'
new_line = '[ ] Taking a solo backpacking trip'

count_old = content.count(old_line)
count_new = content.count(new_line)
print('old_line occurrences', count_old)
print('new_line occurrences before', count_new)

if count_old == 0:
    # try alternative: maybe already not done or different whitespace
    # We'll still attempt a regex replacement from [x] to [ ] for that exact text.
    import re
    pattern = r"\[x\]\s+Taking a solo backpacking trip"
    matches = list(re.finditer(pattern, content))
    print('regex matches', len(matches))

updated = content.replace(old_line, new_line)
print('did replacement change?', updated != content)
print('occurrences after old_line', updated.count(old_line))
print('occurrences after new_line', updated.count(new_line))

# Update the note
resp = apis.simple_note.update_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token, content=updated)
print('update response', resp)

# Verify
note2 = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token)
print('verified new_line occurrences', note2['content'].count(new_line))
print('verified old_line occurrences', note2['content'].count(old_line))
